body.name: Branch-sCIDP
body.construction: Enumerate \(\Omega(\mathcal P;Y,X,C)\). At each \(\rho=(\bar X,\bar C)\), run sIDP on \(J_{\rho}=P(Y,\bar C\mid\operatorname{do}(\bar X),S=\mathbf 1)\). On the first successful deterministic state, return \(F_{\rho}(y,\bar c;\bar x;P_{\mathrm{obs}})/\sum_{y'}F_{\rho}(y',\bar c;\bar x;P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), restoring the original assignments along the trace; otherwise return \(\operatorname{AllFail}\).
